notes: The nominal MECO target lives in the OPS 1 overlay (CGGC01), where no uplink reaches: the DOLILU's VDMAG (message 96) is only the pseudo-target second-stage guidance starts from. With the tape's 25,668 ft/s PASS cut off at 25,605 truth.
VD_NOM: 25,819 ft/s, the STS-134 Ascent Checklist's MECO VI (ASC/134/FIN). The radius and flight-path angle stay the tape's (60 nmi, 0.5 deg): no STS-134 values found.

K_CMD_NOM: second stage's throttle (GG42ND step 5601, 'the rated power level setting'), 100 on the tape; STS-134 flew 104.5% to the 3-g throttling (JSC 37461 Appendix A) -- 104, the command's resolution being 1%. With 100 the simulated stack ran the second stage at 100%.

RD_NOM: STS-134 flew a '52 nautical mile MECO' as a performance enhancement (Space Shuttle Missions Summary, NASA 20110001406, STS-134 page 2-240). PASS's convention is altitude above its equatorial radius a = 20,925,646.3 ft (the tape's own RD_NOM is a + 60.02 nmi), so RD_NOM = a + 52 nmi = 21,241,604 ft. (Previously 21,250,656 ft, 53.5 nmi: 107 km above the ellipsoid at MECO latitude, an unsourced figure.)  FPA_NOM 0.65 deg: no STS-134 value found; with VI 25,819 ft/s it gives a post-MECO apogee near the MOD FRR's 'insertion altitude 122 nm'. The tape's (60 nmi, 0.5 deg) left a 137 x 43 nmi orbit and an OMS-2 of 292 ft/s.

CGGV_RAD_MECO (RDMAG, the pseudo MECO radius second stage flies to until the guidance parameter reset) must equal RD_NOM: CGGC01 initializes both to 21,290,308. The other two pseudo targets, VDMAG and GAMD, come from DOLILU message 96.

cells.name: CGGV_RAD_MECO
cells.value: 21,241,604 ft, the same as RD_NOM: this is the radius PEG flies to until CGGV_GUID_PARM_RESET_GMT (GG42ND step 54), and the flight source initializes it to RD_NOM's value (CGGC01). Left at the tape's 60 nmi, it lofted second stage ~25,000 ft and dove at the switch.

cells.name: CGGS_ASSUMED_SSME_FAIL_MET
cells.value: 0: no second-stage trajectory lofting (TFAIL, FSSR STS 83-0002-34 4.8: 'If trajectory lofting is desired (TFAIL is not zero)...'). No STS-134 value is published; with the tape's 218 s (lofting on until the RTLS/AOA boundary, also 218) PEG lofted second stage ~30,000 ft above the ASCENT ADI - NOMINAL card and dove at the boundary; with 0 its Hdot follows the card (flight p5) and the reserve at MECO is about STS-134's.

cells.name: CGGS_ROLL_CMD_CHANGE_V
cells.value: V_RHO_PHI (FSSR STS 83-0002-34 4.8; a second-stage I-load, not in the DOLILU or the 4.12 uplink groups): the Earth-relative velocity at which second-stage guidance commands PHI_2STG, the roll to heads-up.  The STS-134 Ascent Checklist's cue is 'VI = 13.2K Roll Heads Up'; on the simulated trajectory Vi - Vrel is about 1,207 ft/s there (flight p10: the tape's 12,500 started the roll at Vi ~13,700), so 12,000.
